opening.argument: The video gives a concrete, ordinary redemption instruction: go to Netflix's redemption page and enter a gift-card code. The visible page has a code or PIN field and a Redeem button. The speaker also describes buying gift cards online or in store, while a retail page shows gift-card products for sale. These are instructions and purchasing information, not a request to provide private credentials or payment through the video. Viewers are directed to Netflix support for account questions, and the request to subscribe to the channel is routine audience engagement, not a condition for buying or redeeming a gift card.

citations.quote: So how to redeem your Netflix gift card? So it's super easy. You just need to go to netflix.com slash redeem.
You can buy online. You can buy in store.
